output.headline: Provider specialist with an open platform in the target's own sub-sector and the most adjacent provider deals on the priority list.
output.differentiator: Most adjacent provider deals on the priority list (18) and more own-sub-sector deals (4) than any other sponsor; its open platform gives an add-on route. [T:record, A:angles]
output.why_them: Add-on to its open platform in the sub-sector; provider specialist

acquirer_overview.title: Provider-focused sponsor with a long, mostly completed record
points: Financial sponsor with 24 deals from 2016 to 2024; 21 of 24 (88%) closed and 9 since 2022. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:recent]
Healthcare is one of four industries it invests in; Fund XI closed at its EUR 9 billion hard cap (about $11 billion). [P:1, P:2]
22 of 24 deals are provider services; its home sub-sector is Physician Groups, with 10 deals. [A:angles, K:by_sub_sector, B:buyer]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Add-on route into an open platform in the target's sub-sector
points: Four deals in the target's own sub-sector and 18 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; the open platform makes this target an add-on. [T:record, A:angles]
Platform Build is a stated motive in 7 of 24 deals, matching the add-on route this target offers. [M:platform_build]
Only 2 deals in the Midwest, a slight factor against, but its 2024 Principal Physician Group recapitalization was in the Midwest. [S:geo_fit, T:record, D:MA-2024-0431]

precedent_activity.title: Own-sub-sector precedents include $991M and $1,304M buyouts
points: Green Medical Center, 2022: $1,304M leveraged buyout at 15.0x EV/EBITDA; closed. [D:MA-2022-0045]
Harbor Medical Center, 2023: $991M leveraged buyout at 11.1x; Harbor Health Network, 2024: $35M carve-out at 11.6x. Both closed. [D:MA-2023-0466, D:MA-2024-0339]
Principal Physician Group, 2024: $76M Midwest recapitalization at 15.9x; 8 of 24 deals sit in the $100M-$400M size band. [D:MA-2024-0431, K:size_band]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible; Nordic's own history sits lower
points: Comparable range 10.7x to 15.3x, median 12.8x; 75th percentile is defensible as the 16.8% margin beats the 12.9% comps median. [V:comps]
Its median paid is 12.5x, below the comps median, yet it paid 15.0x for Green Medical Center and 15.9x for Principal. [V:comps, D:MA-2022-0045, D:MA-2024-0431]
Max price $193M on the same exit, $216M on a platform exit at 15.0x; IRR at ask 18.7% versus 20% target. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Median deal of $77M is under half the $200M EV.
risk_flags.mitigant: It has done deals up to $1,304M, and 8 of 24 sit in the $100M-$400M band.
risk_flags.reality: A stretch on the median, not on the record. [T:record, K:size_band]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the $200M ask is 18.7%, below the 20% target.
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x supports a price up to $216M.
risk_flags.reality: Works with the add-on exit case; the same-exit ceiling is $193M. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Midwest depth and competing bidders
risk_flags.concern: Only 2 Midwest deals; Welsh Carson and GTCR have deeper Midwest records and pay higher multiples.
risk_flags.mitigant: Four own-sub-sector deals and an open platform give a stronger operating fit.
risk_flags.reality: Geography is only a slight factor against; it bought in the Midwest in 2024. [S:geo_fit, D:MA-2024-0431]

conviction.rationale: Four own-sub-sector and 18 adjacent provider deals, an open-platform add-on route and #2 position on the priority list support High, offset by a median deal of $77M, under half the $200M EV. [C:conviction, R:rank]
